name: scrambled eggs
ingredients: 2 eggs, 1 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp milk, 1 pinch salt
instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, and salt in a bowl.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Pour in eggs and stir gently until cooked.

name: classic pancakes
ingredients: 1 cup flour, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 cup milk, 1 eggs, 2 tbsp butter
instructions:
Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter together.
Combine wet and dry ingredients.
Cook scoops of batter on a hot griddle until golden.

name: pasta
ingredients: 200 g pasta, 1 cup tomato sauce, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tbsp olive oil
instructions:
Boil pasta in salted water until ready.
Sauté minced garlic in olive oil.
Add tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Toss the pasta into the sauce and mix well.

name: mug chocolate cake
ingredients: 4 tbsp flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp cocoa powder, 3 tbsp milk, 1 tbsp oil
instructions:
Whisk dry ingredients directly inside a microwave-safe mug.
Add milk and oil, then stir until smooth.
Microwave on high for 70 to 90 seconds.

name: lemon cake
ingredients: 2 cups flour, 1.5 cups sugar, 3 eggs, 0.5 cup butter, 0.75 cup milk, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp lemon zest
instructions:
Preheat oven to 180 degrees.
Cream butter and sugar together until fluffy.
Add eggs one by one then stir in lemon juice and zest.
Alternate adding flour and milk until smooth.
Bake in a greased pan for 35 minutes.

name: cheese sandwich
ingredients: 2 slices of Bread, 1 slice of Cheese, 1 tablespoon of Butter
instructions:
Put the cheese between the bread. 
Spread butter on the bread. 
Toast it for 2 minutes.

name: cookies
ingredients: 200 g Flour, 100 g Butter, 50 g Brown Sugar, 50 g Chocolate
instructions:
Mix butter and brown sugar.
 Add flour and chocolate chips.
 Bake for 10 minutes
